definitions.explanation: The traditional name of the fourth month of the old lunar calendar, now used as a poetic name for April in calendars, letters, haiku, and shop or product names.

examples.japanese: {卯月|うづき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ。
⟦{旧暦|きゅうれき}→旧暦：12958_kyuureki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{卯月|うづき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{五月|ごがつ}→五月：00625_gogatsu⟧ごろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あたる。
examples.english: Uzuki in the old calendar corresponds to roughly May today.

examples.japanese: {卯月|うづき}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{卯|う}の{花|はな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The name Uzuki is said to come from its being the month when deutzia flowers bloom.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Each month of the old calendar has a traditional name: ⟦{睦月|むつき}→睦月：18674_mutsuki⟧ (first), ⟦{如月|きさらぎ}→如月：20361_kisaragi⟧ (second), ⟦{弥生|やよい}→弥生：20353_yayoi⟧ (third), {卯月|うづき} (fourth), and so on. Because the lunar calendar ran about a month behind today's, these names fit the season of the month after: {卯月|うづき} is early summer in old poetry.

REGISTER:
Literary; in everyday speech and writing April is ⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧.
